caption: The drawing displays a detailed depiction of a mechanical device composed primarily of metal elements. The visible portion of the object includes a curved metallic section with intricate engraved patterns, shaded in shades of silver, gray, blue, and brown to highlight texture and dimensionality. There are several circular components, including a central gear-like disc with radiating engraved lines, surrounded by small raised knobs. The object also features a curved handle in a dark brown color and coiled copper-colored springs attached to upright brackets. The design includes mutliple bolts and connecting joints, and a ring structure at the upper right. The left side of the object is only partially rendered, with light pencil outlines suggesting its shape and position but lacking color or detail. The artist's signature, “Harry Mann Waddell,” is written in the lower right corner. The background is plain and off-white, lacking any additional objects or scenery.
title: Spade Bit
